During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] held a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mon Eron]] in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. Refugees were sent here from the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Iceberg Three]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched an invasion of the [[Star system/Legends|system]].
